title: Encoder · Causal patch bottleneck MAE
summary: Preserve the CPB family and CPB-v3 clean baseline. V14 measurements are saved; research and its unfinished registry finalization remain paused.

goals.title: Preserve causal source and scoped measurements
goals.description: Keep clean baselines, candidate evidence and historical protocol differences distinct.

milestones.title: Preserve CPB source, baselines and pause boundary
milestones.description: The family and handoff are retained. CPB-v3.market-01 remains the clean causal baseline; the handoff records the exact user-requested research pause.
acceptance: Family source and the authoritative pause handoff are retained under the verified migration.

milestones.title: Preserve completed V14 measurements and trust records
milestones.description: Saved V14 evidence records full trust and coverage, 3/22 current protected conditions and no new protected record or overall winner. Counts from earlier protocols are not directly comparable; this dashboard does not replay or rescore research.
acceptance: The V14 results, independent audit review and final evidence join exist and the handoff records their completion and limitations.

goals.title: Resolve admitted registry and provider work
goals.description: Registry review and an operation-facing provider are separate future steps; preserve the existing research pause.

milestones.title: Review pending V14 registry proposals after explicit resumption
milestones.description: Three unapplied proposals are preserved. Independent proposal review, metadata application and final preservation closure remain unfinished. The existing pause must be explicitly lifted for the relevant scope before these research actions resume; a Hero edit, starter path or probe is not resumption authorization.
acceptance: Resolve and retain the authoritative handoff and an explicit scope-specific resumption record before proposal review, metadata application, replay, rescoring or further paused research is executed.

Keep CPB-v3.market-01, preserved V14 measurements and historical protocol limits unchanged unless an independently authorized, versioned action expressly addresses them. Do not infer a winner, completed registry finalization or permission from preserved done milestones.
If authorization is absent or the handoff does not clearly permit a proposed action, record the blocked action and missing authorization; do not downgrade it to a diagnostic task to bypass the pause.

milestones.title: Define and verify the causal provider contract
milestones.description: Define a provider contract for an explicitly selected, scope-authorized CPB instance while preserving the research pause. Contract drafting and examination of preserved records do not authorize runtime work, registry changes, replay or rescoring outside the authoritative handoff.
acceptance: Before executing provider checks or diagnostic probes, resolve whether that exact action is permitted by the handoff or a new explicit authorization. Otherwise retain the work as proposed with an authorization blocker; this review does not lift the pause.

Bind native shape, masks, output-position semantics, preprocessing, checkpoint/fit identity and per-output temporal support under shared contracts. Keep causal input dependence, model availability and task usefulness as separate testable claims.
When authorized, test cutoff/perturbation behavior at the declared output positions, source lineage, non-finite handling and SpaceRef compatibility independently of forecasting or operation quality.
Preserved V14 results, pending proposals and historical protocols are neither modified nor reinterpreted as part of provider integration; a new admitted run has its own evidence identity and scope.
